newsitem.title: UK: Croatia mark Eurobond mandate due soon - dealers.
newsitem.headline: Croatia mark Eurobond mandate due soon - dealers.

text.p: Croatia is expected to announce which banks will underwrite its debut mark Eurobond in the coming days, bankers said on Tuesday.
"The mandate for Croatia is due in the next 24 hours," an emerging debt trader at a European bank said.
He declined to comment on which bank had won the contest, and dealers elsewhere also said it was not yet known which banks would lead manage the issue.
Last week, Slovenia mandated Credit Suisse First Boston and Dresdner Kleinwort Benson to lead manage its debut mark Eurobond.
Croatian officials said in April it would launch a mark bond in the middle of the year.
It tapped the international capital markets for the first time in February with a $300 million five-year bond, priced to yield 80 basis points over U.S. Treasury notes at launch.
Croatia is rated Baa3 by Moody's Investors Service and BBB minus by Standard & Poor's.
On Tuesday, the Croatian Bank for Reconstruction and Development, guaranteed by Croatia, launched a 700 million Austrian schilling five-year bond.
The deal was aimed at Austrian retail investors.
